description:
## Problem
Open upstream work on datafusion-contrib/tpcgen-rs from BenchBox-dev/tpcgen-rs: PR #675 (--no-trailing-delimiter; no longer needed by BenchBox, left open as a contribution), issue #676 and PR #677 (Scaling override: `Scaling::with_row_counts`, `SessionBuilder::with_scaling`). Not yet reported: the Arrow wrappers clamp row ranges to upstream's own sub-scale counts (truncated customer_address and web_page at SF 0.05), there is no seed on Session, and there are no refresh-set generators. Closed PR #644 (qgen and dbgen -U) may get successors.

## Change
Respond to upstream review on #675 and #677; file the wrapper-clamp bug with a reproduction; open the refresh-set proposal if the policy decision keeps that code. On each upstream release, check whether it contains #677 or refresh generators; if so, switch the library back to the crates.io pin, delete the carried patch or own code, and re-run the parity matrix.

## Decision gates
- Never block library delivery on upstream timing.
- If upstream rejects #677, report to the owner: the carried patch then becomes permanent and needs a renewed decision.
- Close #675 only if upstream asks or the owner says so.

## Guardrails
- BenchBox work only in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, make agent-write-preflight); the primary clone is read-only.
- Heavy work only through make heavy-run; never bypass or signal the lock, and never kill processes by name pattern (pkill -f); stop only PIDs you started.
- Commits as the configured human identity; no agent attribution.
- No carried or own reimplementation of upstream code without the owner decision recorded in datagen-decision-upstream-gap-policy.
- A choice between a small and a large implementation path goes to the owner with sizes before work starts.
- Report only results that were observed; name anything not run.
